actions: Add child-only case-insensitive environment removal to ManagedProcessSpec
Construct the child Unicode environment block without explicitly removed inherited variables
Keep process-global environment untouched and preserve Job Object process ownership
Use the removal primitive in LB-008 so ambient tunnel-client credentials/configuration cannot silently override LocalBridge production arguments
records.reason: LB-008 deterministic execution proved that substituting an empty value for an inherited optional variable is not equivalent to removal: tunnel-client rejects CLOUDFLARED_TUNNEL_TOKEN when it is set but empty. True child-only removal is required to isolate Runtime API Key/configuration from the parent environment without plaintext files, process-global mutation, or a duplicate process launcher.
